details: US President Donald Trump met with cryptocurrency industry executives at the White House, urging Congress to pass the "Clarity Act" to provide clearer regulatory definitions for digital assets. He also acknowledged discussions within his administration about potentially acquiring significant amounts of Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies for the US, though no concrete acquisition plans were announced. This signals a continued pro-crypto stance from the administration.
title: Trump Pushes for 'Clarity Act,' Hints at US Bitcoin Holdings

details: The US Treasury is reportedly contemplating utilizing up to $1 trillion from its General Account to execute buybacks of long-term government bonds. This initiative follows an earlier move to double the size of its regular buyback operations, aiming to mitigate the rise in long-dated Treasury yields. Market participants are closely monitoring the effectiveness of these measures and their broader implications for Federal Reserve monetary policy.
title: US Treasury Considers $1 Trillion Bond Buybacks Amid Yield Surge

details: The cryptocurrency market faces a pivotal week as investors await key US macroeconomic data, including the July Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) inflation report and revised Q2 GDP figures, both due on Wednesday. Additionally, Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh's highly anticipated keynote speech at the Jackson Hole Economic Policy Symposium on Friday will be closely scrutinized for insights into future monetary policy. Economists anticipate core PCE inflation to remain above the Fed's 2% target, which could impact interest rate expectations and introduce volatility to risk assets like cryptocurrencies.
title: Crucial Week Ahead: US Economic Data and Jackson Hole Symposium
